top_concerns: Headline results use an oracle gold schema built with knowledge of the test questions; the realistic InferredSchema variant is much weaker and loses to VectorRAG and OAI on FinanceBench aggregative questions
Limited novelty: LLM schema induction plus text-to-SQL is close to Evaporate and prior text-to-table work, with no comparison to it or to agentic/map-reduce aggregation baselines
Benchmarks fit the method: synthetic HOTELS and a 22-document WorldCup are small and single-schema; only 50 FinanceBench aggregative queries, no variance or significance
Baselines are confounded or weak: GPT-4o for S-RAG vs o3 for baselines, a single VectorRAG configuration, a FullCorpus that cannot hold the corpus, an opaque OAI system
Unvalidated LLM-judge evaluation and no error analysis or ablations (record accuracy, SQL accuracy, schema-induction size, ingestion cost)
